title: Lamb Vindaloo
description: Succulent lamb cooked low and slow in a classic, fiery vindaloo sauce.

method.instruction: Prepare 1 batch of [[vindaloopaste|Vindaloo Paste]] according to the vindaloo paste recipe. Set aside.
Place lamb in a large bowl. Add vindaloo paste and toss to coat evenly. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or overnight for deeper flavour.
Heat vegetable oil in a large heavy-based pot over medium-high heat. Add onions and sauté 2–3 minutes until soft and translucent. Add garlic and sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add turmeric, chili powder, tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, and vinegar. Cook 2–3 minutes until tomatoes break down.
Add marinated lamb and sugar. Season with salt. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in hot water, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour or until lamb is tender and sauce has thickened.
If sauce is too thin, uncover and simmer for a further 5–10 minutes to reduce.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with steamed rice.

notes.title: Overnight Marinade
notes.content: For the deepest flavour, marinate the lamb overnight in the refrigerator. The vinegar and spices will tenderise the meat while infusing it with flavour.

notes.title: Paste Yield
notes.content: The vindaloo paste recipe yields approximately 80–100 g — exactly the right amount for 1 kg of lamb. Use the full batch.

notes.title: Recipe Source
notes.content: Adapted from traditional Indian vindaloo recipes.
